notes: Hand-assembled, not generated by `tubuild.py create`: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main, so there was no candidate id to create from. The schema follows the arm9/dCc_c and arm9/Clipper entries, which took the same route.

dCcAc_c is the cylinder collision primitive attached to an dActor_c: Init fixes radius/height/flags on the dCc_c base and stores the owner back-pointer; both virtuals read through owner (GetPos returns the owner's dActor_c+0x5c position, GetOwnerID returns owner->uniqueID at +4).

dCcAcPos_c, the derived class adding Vector3 pos at +0x34, folds into the same TU for its non-lifecycle members: SetPosRelativeToActor and Init open the run at 0x0201489c/0x020148c8 and the slot-3 veneer plus GetPos close it at 0x02014a20/0x02014a2c. PosInit stays a mangled extern "C" definition under the same wall 6az as the base Init; func_02014a20 stays a helper under its address name because the cartridge emitted a linker veneer, not a member body (method-review dCcAcPos_c.tsv: slot-3 inheritance veneer, not an override).

The dCcAcPos_c lifecycle trio (D0 at 0x02014a34, D1 at 0x02014a60, C1 at 0x02014a84) stays in its own files: ~dCcAcPos_c is the class key function, so defining it here re-emits _ZTV10dCcAcPos_c, and the emitted record binds slot 3 to _ZN7dCcAc_c10GetOwnerIDEv while the cartridge record carries the linker veneer func_02014a20 -- a deadstrip-data compare that cannot pass, and the shared-header override spelling that would fix it is one the header deliberately omits.

The whole class folds, lifecycle variants included: the cartridge's D2,D0,D1,C1,C2 order for dCcAc_c is the order one ~dCcAc_c() plus one dCcAc_c() emits under deferred codegen; the run is written ROM-descending because mwccarm emits .text in reverse source order, so the emitted object carries the eleven functions ascending 0x0201489c..0x02014a34.
